cases.input: IP A moves from endpoint E1 to E2 at T2.
cases.expect: E1 and E2 remain distinct; two non-overlapping bindings preserve history.

cases.input: One logical endpoint exposes blue and green runtime resources during migration.
cases.expect: Endpoint identity remains stable while scoped bindings overlap explicitly.

cases.input: API contract advances from R1 to R2 at the same URL.
cases.expect: Contract pin changes; endpoint and address binding remain stable.

cases.input: An API URL changes without semantic contract change.
cases.expect: A new address binding supersedes the old one; contract revision is unchanged.

cases.input: A declared route has no current telemetry.
cases.expect: Connectivity remains declared with observation status unknown, not asserted reachable.

cases.input: A credential value is offered as endpoint metadata.
cases.expect: Reject secret material and retain only an indirect governed reference.

cases.input: Resolve an endpoint address before and after retirement.
cases.expect: Historical lookup returns the then-valid binding; current lookup returns retired state and successor.
